UserProfilePublic.title: UserProfilePublic
UserProfilePublic.description: Publicly visible non-PII user profile metadata for Abrar Medical Store operators.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name of the operator (1 to 100 chars).

UserProfilePrivate.title: UserProfilePrivate
UserProfilePrivate.description: Owner-only private user profile document containing PII such as email.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

StoreWorkspace.title: StoreWorkspace
StoreWorkspace.description: Parent store workspace document used as the relational Master Gate for subcollections.

storeId.description: Unique store identifier matching the document ID.

storeName.description: Name of the medical store (1 to 120 chars).

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

SyncCheckpointNote.title: SyncCheckpointNote
SyncCheckpointNote.description: Cloud sync checkpoint note and audit log recorded under a store workspace.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note creator.

note.description: Sync checkpoint summary or note (1 to 600 chars).

recordCount.description: Total SQLite records verified at checkpoint time (0 to 10000000).

status.description: Checkpoint status; archived checkpoints are locked from non-admin edits.

BusinessSyncBatch.title: BusinessSyncBatch
BusinessSyncBatch.description: Deterministic, checksum-verified batch of Local SQLite business transactions uploaded or restored strictly via Manual Sync.

storeId.description: Parent store ID matching the /stores/{storeId} path.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator who uploaded the batch.

tableName.description: Business table name (e.g., sales, sale_items, purchases, accounts, journal_entries, inventory).

batchIndex.description: Zero-based index of this batch within the sync session (0 to 10000).

totalBatches.description: Total number of batches in the sync session (1 to 10000).

recordCount.description: Number of business rows serialized in this batch (0 to 100000).

recordsPayload.description: JSON-serialized array of business table rows (2 to 800000 chars).

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of recordsPayload (8 to 128 chars).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the sync batch.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Private PII user profile data restricted to owner or admin.

/stores/{storeId}/syncNotes/{noteId}.description: Sync checkpoint notes gated by parent store ownership.

/stores/{storeId}/syncBatches/{batchId}.description: Manual business transaction sync batches gated by parent store ownership.
